results.title: Development must reach every sector, from grassroots to state level: Tripura CM
results.description: Tripura Chief Minister Manik Saha today criticised the Left Front government for failing to work for the upliftment of the people and the development of the state despite ruling it for a long time Saha said this while inaugurating and laying foundation stones for various projects in Unakoti district

results.title: EXPLAINER | How CAFE-III could bring more small EVs on the roads
results.description: India's CAFE-III norms (2027–2032) aim for a 16.7% fuel-efficiency boost. Featuring 3x super credits for BEVs and REEVs, the framework incentivizes high-volume, affordable EVs and hybrids to offset larger SUV emissions across automaker fleets.
